verdict.rationale: Ramp documents built-in agents that run continuously in the background: auto-coding, real-time fraud and anomaly scanning, approval routing, receipt capture, auto top-up to a target balance, and automatic hotel rebooking. It also explicitly supports "long-running access for background agents that run on a schedule" through per-agent keys and a CLI built for scripted and scheduled workflows, with webhooks for event triggers. missing for 10: a documented user-facing builder or scheduler for creating custom automations inside Ramp (external agent schedules run on the user's own infrastructure), some money movement still requires human confirmation, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the autonomous behavior.
